name: comp-342
title: Accordion Icon Subheader Chevron
description: A four-row accordion for account settings. Each row has a circular icon, a bold title and a grey subtitle; clicking a row opens its paragraph and closes the one before.
use: Grouping related settings or FAQ answers so only one explanation is open at a time.
avoid: Rows are text-height with muted body copy, which can be hard to read and tap on small screens.
a11y: Triggers are real buttons with visible focus rings and icon decoration hidden from screen readers; there is no reduced-motion check. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A four-row list under a bold heading. Each row starts with a small grey icon inside a thin circular outline, then a bold title with a grey subtitle beneath, and a downward chevron at the right edge. Thin dividers separate rows, and the open row shows an indented paragraph of muted text.
behaves: Clicking a row expands its paragraph with a short height animation, rotates its chevron upward and closes any other open row. The third row starts open; clicking it again collapses it.
customise: Rows, icons, titles, subtitles and paragraph copy all live in one array in the file, so editing them means editing the source; styling comes from utility classes.
weight: light: Four short rows and a height and chevron transition; nothing runs in the background.
